_comment: Branch protection config applied to main of every MiraNote-AI repo. Mirrors the dasgpt pattern. `required_status_checks` is null in day-1 because the reusable-workflow context names cannot be confirmed until Phase 5 (first PR run). After Phase 5, switch to the version with `required_status_checks` populated -- see branch-protection-with-checks.json once you've observed the actual context name from a real workflow run.
